title: Positivity of Krawtchouk values below the smallest zero
statement: Let $n$ and $t$ be natural numbers with $t + 1 \le n$, and let $K_j^{(n)}$ denote the degree-$j$ Krawtchouk polynomial associated with $n$. Suppose $a$ is a real number lying strictly below every real zero of $K_t^{(n)}$: that is, $a < \xi$ whenever $K_t^{(n)}(\xi) = 0$. Then $K_j^{(n)}(a) > 0$ for every $j$ with $j \le t$.
